title: Horizon and Signal
author: Odile Dunmore
blurb: Sable Almeida, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
